text:
noelle: Heads-up: I'm consolidating a short list of phrasing decisions we need to lock before the next docs canary. Small scope: naming collisions, UI labels, and sample param keys. Will batch into tiny PRs. Quick read? cc @sam @maya @leo

sam: Quick thoughts: prefer 'model variant' (two words) in prose, but UI labels should show 'Variant' (capitalized single word). Keep 'replica' internal only.

maya: Agree on Variant. Also want to settle 'rollout' vs 'release' across guides. Suggest: 'rollout' for gradual deploys, 'release' for a named version/announcement.

leo: +1. For UI copy use short verbs: "Roll out" (gradual), "Release" (final). In API docs use technical wording: "deploy" or "apply" as appropriate. I'll draft a 1-paragraph note for the style guide.

noelle: Nice. Another small one: pluralization for metrics — use singular tags for dashboards (latency, throughput) but plural in sentences (requests per second).

sam: Good catch. Also found multiple instances of param keys: model, model_id, modelId, model_variant_id. Proposal: canonical field name = model_id in backend docs; show language-idiomatic keys in SDK snippets and note mapping.

maya: Let's add a short YAML vs SDK callout: YAML/config -> snake_case (model_variant_id); Python -> snake_case; JS -> camelCase (modelVariantId). Include an example mapping table in the style doc (small).

leo: I'll create PR #512 to add those callouts and a tiny examples appendix.

doc-bot: lint: docs check: found 4 curl snippets using form-encoded 'model='; recommend switching to JSON body with "model_id". See examples/curl.md lines 10-24.

noelle: Thanks. I'll do a sweep for curl examples and open #513 to update them to JSON bodies and include an alias snippet. Example to include in PR:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_id":"gpt-3","input":"Hello"}'
```

noelle: Also want to avoid the term 'flavor' in public docs — sounds informal. If infra wants to use it internally, fine, but don't teach it to users.

sam: Agreed. We should add a short blacklist: flavor, magic, seamless (marketing-y) — to the voice section. Keep API docs neutral and instructive.

maya: I'll proofread the blacklist and suggest alternatives (e.g., 'configuration', 'variant', 'profile').

leo: For the glossary entry on 'replica' vs 'variant' propose this sentence: "Variant: a user-facing model configuration or checkpoint. Replica: an internal runtime copy used for scaling and availability." Short and clear.

noelle: Perfect. Let's also add an automated redirect plan: if any public doc contains 'flavor' or 'replica', create a docs redirect to the glossary note and open a tiny PR to replace the copy. Helps prevent accidental public use.

doc-bot: CI: preview site built for branches/512,513 (previews available)

sam: I'll take PR #513 (curl/body changes). Will ping here when ready for review.

maya: Taking the blacklist and phrasing edits in #512; will add examples and short rationale.

noelle: Great. Plan: merge small PRs by EOD Wednesday, canary Thursday 09:00 UTC. If you pick something else up, ping here to avoid overlap. Thanks! :sparkles:
